package.description: Remote desktop you’ll actually love, in crystal clear, interactive HD. Connect to work, games, or projects wherever you are, whenever you want.

en-US.description: Remote desktop you’ll actually love, in crystal clear, interactive HD. Connect to work, games, or projects wherever you are, whenever you want.
en-US.longDescription:
Parsec is a proprietary freeware desktop capturing application primarily used for playing games
through video streaming.

Using Parsec, a user can stream video game footage through an Internet connection, allowing one to
run a game on one computer but play it remotely through another device.

Although its main focus is gaming, Parsec can also be used as low-latency desktop sharing software.
en-US.name: Parsec
